meta.title: Process lens
meta.description: Click "Process lens" in the title bar to open a side drawer that explains each step of the assistant's work in three plain lines: what it did, what happened, and how it ended. Explanations use the plugin's own model (Settings → Explanation model, following the current session by default) and only run when you ask: Generate on one step, Generate all, or turn on explain-while-open yourself. Merge every N steps is on by default at 5: while the drawer is open, one request is sent per 5 steps and those steps share a single summary instead of one request each; nothing runs while the drawer is closed unless run in background is on. Steps that only call tools are written locally instead of calling a model (Tool steps skip the model), using the tool name, its arguments, and success or failure, and carry a local tag; pressing Generate on that step still uses the model. A request contains only that step's thinking excerpt, answer excerpt, tool names with arguments and results, and the request of that turn; no other session is read. Step records live in memory and are lost on restart; one settings file is saved on disk, and Storage at the bottom of Settings shows its path and size and lets you clear each part. Disabling the plugin leaves the main conversation unchanged apart from losing the drawer.
